Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Show the exact S1-S5 Seiton execute slot in Crystalline Conflict.
Description: A display-only Ninja PvP overlay that maps FFXIV's native enemy slots to S1-S5 and shows the matching label only when an enemy is below 50% HP, passes Seiton's native range check, and Seiton is currently usable.
Changelog: Facing hotfix: a valid execute label now remains visible when FFXIV reports only that you are not facing the enemy; real range, line-of-sight, and unknown failures still hide it.
